related.title: 海風蘇格蘭浮式風場
related.why: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.whyEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.transfer: 可遷移能量守恆、熱路、載荷與驗證證據；熱源、工作流體及安全邊界不同。
related.transferEn: Energy conservation, heat paths, loads and validation evidence transfer, with different heat sources, fluids and safety boundaries.
related.difference: 本課針對浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電；海風蘇格蘭浮式風場改以spar 支撐、繫泊與浮式經驗遷移為架構重點，不能直接沿用幾何、邊界或產品數值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on floating concrete supports and platform electricity; Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm centers on spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer, so geometry, boundaries and product values cannot transfer unchanged.
practice: 對照Tampen風資源與Scotland風分佈，重畫兩項工程的輸入及系統邊界。
把本課假想算例移到海風蘇格蘭浮式風場，列出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以海況與供電可用率為起點，設計一項能區分「浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電」與「spar 支撐、繫泊與浮式經驗遷移」的觀測，註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare tampen wind resources with scotland wind distribution and redraw inputs and boundaries.
Transfer the assumed example to Hywind Scotland Floating Wind Farm, separating reusable equations from respecified parameters.

Start from sea states/power availability and propose an observation distinguishing floating concrete supports and platform electricity from spar supports, mooring and floating-design transfer, including uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: Hywind Tampen 浮式風電
history.text: Hywind Tampen 浮式風電的公開資料展示浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電的工程脈絡；本課以不同功能層與可驗證輸出重建教學案例，不宣稱取得任何專有製造流程。
history.textEn: Public sources for Hywind Tampen floating wind illustrate floating concrete supports and platform electricity. The course reconstructs functional layers and verifiable outputs educationally without proprietary manufacturing access.

history.title: 從工程故事到可檢查模型
history.titleEn: From engineering story to reviewable models
history.text: 本課將浮式混凝土支撐與油氣平臺供電改寫為原創離線分析題；不複製來源的製造圖、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns floating concrete supports and platform electricity into original offline analysis exercises without copying manufacturing drawings, video transcripts or field procedures.

roles.role: Hywind Tampen 的開發與營運商。
roles.roleEn: Developer and operator of Hywind Tampen.
roles.business: 挪威能源公司，營運北海油氣田、Sleipner 碳封存與 Hywind 浮動風場。
roles.businessEn: Norwegian energy company operating North Sea fields, Sleipner CO2 storage and Hywind floating wind.

roles.role: 旗下 Siemens Gamesa 供應 11 部 SG 8.0-167 DD 風機。
roles.roleEn: Its Siemens Gamesa unit supplied the 11 SG 8.0-167 DD turbines.
roles.business: 發電與電網設備集團，旗下 Siemens Gamesa 供應離岸風機。
roles.businessEn: Power-generation and grid group whose Siemens Gamesa unit supplies offshore wind turbines.

roles.role: （併入的 Kværner）承建混凝土浮式基礎。
roles.roleEn: (Through merged Kværner) built the concrete floating substructures.
roles.business: 挪威海事工程公司（2022 年併入 Kværner），建造 Hywind Tampen 混凝土浮體。
roles.businessEn: Norwegian offshore engineering firm (merged with Kværner) that built the Hywind Tampen concrete floaters.

courses.connection: 從「Hywind Tampen 浮式風電」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Hywind Tampen floating wind. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
